segments.sn17.2:1.2: “dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.2:1.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, bāḷisiko āmisagataṃ baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya.
segments.sn17.2:1.5: Evañhi so, bhikkhave, maccho gilabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa”.
segments.sn17.2:2.3: Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti nikāmeti, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
segments.sn17.2:2.4: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.2:2.6: ‘uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma, na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī’ti.

lines: Yathākāmakaraṇīyoti yathākāmena yathāruciyā yatheva naṃ bāḷisiko icchati, tathevassa kattabboti attho.
Yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimatoti yathā kilesamārassa kāmo, evaṃ kattabbo, nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā pettivisayaṃ vā pāpetabbo.
Ayo vuccati sukhaṃ, tabbidhuratāya anayo, dukkhanti āha “dukkhaṃ patto”ti.
Yathā kilesā vattanti, evaṃ pavattamāno puggalo kilesavippayogo na hotīti vuttaṃ “yathā kilesamārassa kāmo, evaṃ kattabbo”ti.
